text:
alex: Hey support — after we rolled a change to Okta claim mapping yesterday, several engineers get 403 when switching projects in the console. Okta SSO users only. Anyone else seeing this?

mira: @alex sorry to hear that. Can you paste minimal repro steps and one example 403 payload? Also need org_id and one affected user external_id.

alex: Repro steps:
```
1) Sign in via Okta SSO (SAML)
2) Click org switcher -> select org ACME-Prod (org_8f7a)
3) Console shows modal: "You don't have permission to access this org" and network 403 on /api/v1/projects/lookup
```
Response snippet:
```json
{"error":"forbidden","message":"organization access denied","status":403}
```
Affected user example: external_id: okta|12345

mira: Do those users still show a role in the org members page (Member/Viewer/etc)? Also did you change the Okta attribute key name recently (e.g. from `roles` -> `app_roles`)?

alex: Members page shows them as "Member" but the switch action errors. We did change attribute name from `roles` -> `app_roles` in the mapping yesterday; only some users hit the 403.

jordan: Sounds like a claim-key rename + role-propagation gap. When the IdP claim key changes, our provisioning keeps the old bindings until a resync. Can you confirm org_id and one user id so I can search logs?

alex: org_id: org_8f7a, user external_id: okta|12345 (same as above).

mira: I opened an internal ticket SUP-4621 and queued an authz-resync for org_8f7a. Workarounds: (1) ask the user to sign out -> clear cookies -> sign in (forces fresh token), or (2) re-invite the user which triggers membership re-provisioning.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-4621 created: https://redwood.support/tickets/SUP-4621 :ticket:

ryan_ops: Running resync now: `authz-resync --org org_8f7a --force` — kicking off job j-93b2, ETA ~2min. Will post job status.

jordan: FYI there is a corner case: delegated/ephemeral tokens issued before mapping changes may retain old scopes until they expire (~24h). Sign-out is fastest mitigation.

alex: Ok testing sign-out + sign-in on one affected user now.

(10m later)
alex: Quick update — signed out + cleared cookies + sign-in restored console access for the test user. Looks like sign-in forces the new claim set.

mira: :thumbsup: Good. Jordan, can you add a short runbook entry for IdP claim-key migrations (resync step + recommended user guidance)? Also consider adding an automated resync trigger when mapping schema changes are detected.

jordan: Will add runbook and PR to infra ops. Also added automated resync to our migration checklist.

support-bot: SUP-4621 updated: authz-resync job j-93b2 completed, status: SUCCESS.

alex: Confirmed: all previously affected users in org_8f7a can switch projects now. Closing from our side ✅

mira: Thanks @alex — marking resolved. If you see this anywhere else, ping support and include org_id + sample external_id so we can target resync faster.
